model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the relationship between coverage and the number of completions (k) for four different Llama model configurations: Llama-3B, Llama-3B + FT, Llama-1B, and Llama-1B + FT. The x-axis, labeled “Number of completions (k),” uses a logarithmic scale ranging from 2⁰ (1) to 2⁸ (256), with tick marks at each power of two. The y-axis, labeled “Coverage,” uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.8, with major gridlines at intervals of 0.2. The Llama-3B line (blue with circle markers, solid line) starts at approximately 0.38 when k=1 and rises to about 0.48 at k=256. The Llama-3B + FT line (green with triangle markers, dashed line) begins near 0.39 and increases to roughly 0.46. The Llama-1B line (light blue with square markers, solid line) starts at around 0.25 and reaches approximately 0.38. The Llama-1B + FT line (light green with diamond markers, dashed line) begins at about 0.26 and ends near 0.36. All lines show an upward trend as k increases, with Llama-3B consistently achieving the highest coverage across all values of k.
